purpose: Decompose the broad DreamLedger marketplace ambition into bounded jobs that 777 can repeatedly execute, test, and compound without proliferating offers or fabricating economic proof.
north_star: First independently verified external buyer payment followed by correct fulfillment, delivery evidence, and reconciliation. After that, repeatability and scale.

truth.rule: Do not change revenue until independent buyer, authorized action, external result, settled payment, fulfillment, delivery evidence, and reconciliation are linked.

never: count PaymentIntent or checkout creation as revenue
publish thin or duplicate SEO pages
expose GPU host shell, secrets, or unrestricted filesystem/network access
claim billboard inventory without authorized supply
enable a route before route parity and fulfillment are proven

task_graph.objective: Observe a genuinely new 777 run and inspect its exact output before declaring a cycle complete.
acceptance: run ID and event are real
no-op is distinguished from new output

task_graph.objective: Compare the Agent Bridge manifest, catalog, gateway route registry, deployed handler, and customer-facing route.
acceptance: every listed route maps to a deployed handler or is HELD
price and SKU match across surfaces
HTTP method and request schema match

task_graph.objective: Probe the existing toll endpoint without charging or mutating state.
acceptance: no charge and no state mutation

task_graph.objective: Map the existing offer to verified Stripe settlement, entitlement, execution, output, delivery, refund/dispute state, and reconciliation.
acceptance: event signature and idempotency are covered
no fake or synthetic event reaches production ledger

task_graph.objective: Turn each red finding into a minimal fix with a regression test, owner boundary, and independent verification step.
acceptance: each red item has root cause or explicitly UNKNOWN
fix is linked to source and test
CI green is not confused with live economic proof
production mutation waits for approval when required

task_graph.objective: Index existing templates, stencils, word banks, neural-network assets, workflow packs, and connectors before inventing duplicates.
Make verified supplier/service/template discovery useful without charging for browsing.
Prepare a metered Agent Bridge call contract only for routes that pass route parity, safety, and positive measured unit economics.
Evaluate bounded, opt-in GPU inference as a service without exposing the host machine.
Model programmatic DOOH inventory and proof-of-play without claiming unsourced physical supply.
Improve the public website only with distinct, useful, source-backed artifacts and observable quality signals.

iteration_protocol: Inspect run ID, commit, event, jobs, logs, and produced artifacts.
Choose the highest-priority unblocked task; do not open parallel workstreams without a dependency reason.
Generate one bounded artifact with sources, timestamp, schema validation, tests, and content hash.
Run Gauntlet against the artifact and its evidence.
Publish only if the task's publication gate is met; otherwise keep it internal and record the blocker.
Update the existing GitHub epic, Airtable queue, and Notion expedition log with the same evidence IDs.
Repeat. Never claim wealth, demand, or revenue from workflow activity alone.

known_prior_state_to_revalidate.instruction: Treat these as historical until the live manifest and deployed route are freshly fetched.
